packageRules.description: Hold Python on 3.14 (docker image and requires-python): 3.15 is not adopted by most package providers yet (wheels, base images). Patch and digest updates still flow. Remove this rule once 3.15 is widely supported.
OpenTelemetry core and instrumentation packages are released in lockstep, so they must be updated together.
Digest-only updates of already-pinned images carry no new version, so the age gate does not apply.
